name: Zichen Yang
statement: I connect user needs, product decisions and technical constraints to make hardware easier to understand and use.
profileHeadlineEn: I work across product strategy, human factors and hardware development.
profileHeadlineCn: 我关注产品策略、人因研究与硬件开发的交叉。
profileBodyEn: I am Zichen Yang, studying Innovation Design and Technology at The University of Hong Kong. My hardware experience spans prototyping, team coordination and systems that connect people with technology.
profileBodyCn: 我是 Zichen Yang，目前在香港大学学习创新设计与技术。我的硬件项目经历涵盖原型制作、团队协作，以及连接人与技术的系统。
profileFocusEn: Working on automated feeding systems and cleaning robots has taken me from understanding everyday tasks to building and testing prototypes. Field research and collaboration with mechanical and electronic teams helped me connect user needs with technical constraints. These experiences are shaping my direction in product management and human factors research.
profileFocusCn: 在自动投饵系统与清洁机器人项目中，我从理解实际作业流程出发，参与方案定义、原型制作与测试。场景调研，以及与机械、电子团队的合作，让我逐渐学会连接用户需求与技术约束。这些经历也推动我向产品管理与人因研究发展。
profilePrincipleEn: I am interested in how people understand a product, recognise what to do next and use it with confidence. I want to bring that understanding into product priorities and team decisions, then use prototypes to test assumptions and refine the experience. For me, a useful product starts with a clear understanding of the people and context it serves.
profilePrincipleCn: 我关注人们如何理解一个产品、判断下一步操作，并建立使用信心。我希望将这些理解带入产品优先级与团队决策，再通过原型检验假设、完善体验。对我而言，有用的产品始于对使用者及其所处情境的清晰理解。
